rod_tilt5.description: rod tilted 5 deg downwind (rocket holds the rod direction)

rod_1.5m_wind6.description: 1.5 m launch rod, 6 m/s wind + 1.5 m/s gusts

wind6_payload50.description: 6 m/s wind + gusts with the maximum 50 g payload

fin_cant2.description: 2 deg fin cant: strong roll torque the tabs must cancel

cg_aft_20mm.description: CG 20 mm further aft than predicted

slow_servos.description: all servos half speed, 25 ms lag, extra backlash

gyro_drift.description: gyro bias drifting 10x faster than spec

roll_program.description: camera panorama: 90 deg/s roll programme in the coast

coast_rate_only.description: tabs only damp pitch/yaw in the coast (no attitude hold)

tabs_disabled.description: tabs switched off in the settings (TVC only, like KESTREL-1)

motor_curve.description: E20 performing like its published test curve (40 Ns, not the rated 36 Ns)

unarmed_launch.description: FAULT: launched before calibration finished (1 s on the pad)

tvc_off_wind3.description: FAULT: TVC servos dead, 3 m/s wind (tabs still steer)

servo_hardover.description: FAULT: TVC pitch servo jams at full deflection at T+0.5 s

tab_hardover.description: FAULT: tab 1 jams at full deflection at T+1 s

tab_stuck.description: FAULT: tab 2 freezes at T+0.5 s

tabs_dead.description: FAULT: all four tab servos dead from launch

passive_calm.description: FAULT: all 6 steering servos dead (TVC + tabs), calm

passive_wind3.description: FAULT: all 6 steering servos dead, 3 m/s wind

passive_empty_bay.description: FAULT: all steering dead + empty payload bay (least stable), 3 m/s

baro_dead.description: FAULT: barometer dies at T+1 s

passive_wind6.description: FAULT: all steering dead in 6 m/s wind (why first flights need <= 3 m/s)

no_chute.description: FAULT: parachute fails to deploy (shows why ground tests matter)

motor_E12.description: TSP E12-0: NOT for KESTREL-2 (too little thrust for its mass)
